Messages.Author: John Ferretti
Messages.Body:
When is Immortal Grapple played? Is it before maneuvers (pre range) or just
before the strike phase of combat after all maneuvers have been done?
Droz

Messages.Author: Nate Williams
Messages.Body:


The second, I believe. Since it says "play at close range" you have to
wait until range is determined in order to decide whether you can play
it.

As always, LSJ has the final say, so if I'm wrong you'll know soon
enough.

NaTe
